name: NCC Limited
summary: A Hyderabad-based construction company that builds highway packages, buildings, water systems and power projects.
about: NCC started in 1978 as Nagarjuna Construction Company and is now one of India's larger contractors, working across roads, buildings, water supply, irrigation, mining and power. On highways it builds packages under contract to NHAI and state authorities rather than owning or tolling the roads afterwards.
facts: Founded in 1978 as Nagarjuna Construction Company.
Builds highways, buildings, water supply systems, irrigation and power projects.
Works as a contractor rather than a toll road owner.
